question: Where do we go to play with our friends? 🛝
explanation: Super! We go to the beautiful green park to play on swings and slides! 🌳
hint: It has lots of green grass and trees.

question: Where do we buy fresh fruits and vegetables? 🍎
explanation: Awesome! We buy tasty fruits and veggies from the busy market! 🍎
hint: It has lots of shops and stalls.

question: Where do we drop a letter for our friend? ✉️
explanation: Great job! We use the red letterbox at the post office to send mail! 📮
hint: You need stamps to use this place.

question: Where do we keep our money safe? 💰
explanation: Fantastic! The bank keeps our money nice and safe for us! 🏦
hint: It has a big vault.

question: Where do we go to learn new things every day? 🎒
explanation: Excellent! We read, write, and make friends at school! 🏫
hint: Teachers work here.

question: Where do we go when we have a high fever? 🤒
explanation: Wonderful! Doctors at the hospital help us feel much better! 🏥
hint: Nurses take care of people here.

question: Where do we buy a yummy birthday cake? 🎂
explanation: Super! The bakery makes sweet cakes and fresh bread! 🥖
hint: It smells like cookies and sugar.

question: Where do the big red fire engines stay? 🚒
explanation: Awesome! Brave firefighters keep their engines at the fire station! 🚒
hint: They have big water hoses.

question: Where do we go to report a stolen bicycle? 🚲
explanation: Great job! The police station helps keep our neighbourhood very safe! 🚓
hint: People in uniform work here.

question: Where do we buy bandages and medicines? 💊
explanation: Fantastic! The pharmacy sells things to heal our cuts and coughs! 💊
hint: Also known as a chemist shop.

question: Who brings letters and parcels to our home? 📦
explanation: Super! The postman travels the whole neighbourhood to deliver mail! 💌
hint: They wear a special uniform and carry a bag.

question: Who gives us medicine when we are sick? 🩺
explanation: Awesome! The friendly doctor knows exactly how to cure our sickness! 🩺
hint: They wear a white coat.

question: Who helps us read books and do math? 📚
explanation: Great job! Our caring teacher teaches us new and exciting things! 🎒
hint: They write on a blackboard or whiteboard.

question: Who bakes fresh bread and cookies for us? 🍪
explanation: Fantastic! The baker uses flour and sugar to make tasty treats! 🧁
hint: They wear a tall white hat.

question: Who puts out dangerous fires in the town? 🧯
explanation: Wonderful! The brave firefighter uses water to keep us safe from fires! 🚒
hint: They ride in a big red truck.

question: Who catches thieves and keeps the roads safe? 🚓
explanation: Super! The police officer protects our neighbourhood day and night! 🛡️
hint: They wear a badge and a uniform.

question: Who helps the doctor take care of patients? 🩹
explanation: Awesome! The kind nurse checks our temperature and gives us care! 🌡️
hint: They work in a hospital or clinic.

question: Who sells us milk, eggs, and bread? 🥚
explanation: Great job! The shopkeeper runs the local grocery store for us! 🛒
hint: They stand behind a counter.

question: Who sweeps and cleans our neighbourhood streets? 🧹
explanation: Fantastic! The sweeper works hard to keep our surroundings very clean! 🗑️
hint: They use a long broom.

question: Who mends our broken shoes and sandals? 🥾
explanation: Excellent! The cobbler fixes our footwear so we can walk comfortably! 👟
hint: They work with leather and strong thread.

question: What is a simple drawing of our neighbourhood called? 🗺️
explanation: Super! A map helps us find our way around the neighbourhood easily! 📍
hint: It shows roads and places from above.

question: In which direction does the bright sun rise? 🌅
explanation: Awesome! The morning sun always pops up in the East! ☀️
hint: Look where the light comes from in the morning.

question: In which direction does the sun set? 🌇
explanation: Great job! The sun goes to sleep in the West every evening! 🌙
hint: It is the opposite of East.

question: What is the opposite direction of Left? ⬅️
explanation: Fantastic! Right is the opposite way of left! 👉
hint: Most people write with this hand.

question: What is the opposite direction of North? ⬆️
explanation: Wonderful! If you look on a map, South is opposite to North! 📍
hint: It points downwards on a map.

question: What do we use to show a hospital on a map? 🏥
explanation: Super! A red cross is a symbol that means hospital on a map! 🗺️
hint: It is a small sign or picture.

question: What do we call a famous building we use to find our way? 🗼
explanation: Awesome! A landmark is easy to spot and helps us give directions! 🧭
hint: It stands out in the area.

question: Which direction is usually at the top of a map? 🗺️
explanation: Great job! The top of a drawn map always points towards the North! 🧭
hint: Compasses point this way.

question: What colour shows water like rivers on a map? 💧
explanation: Fantastic! Blue color on a map always means cool, splashing water! 🌊
hint: It is the color of the sky.

question: What colour shows parks and trees on a map? 🌲
explanation: Super! Green symbols show us where beautiful nature and parks are! 🌳
hint: It is the color of leaves.

question: Where do we wait to catch a school bus? 🚌
explanation: Awesome! We stand safely at the bus stop until our bus arrives! 🚍
hint: There is a sign by the road.

question: Where do we go to catch a long train? 🚂
explanation: Great job! The train station has long platforms for boarding trains! 🚆
hint: It has tracks on the ground.

question: Where do we go to sit quietly and read books? 📖
explanation: Fantastic! The library is a quiet place filled with wonderful stories! 🤫
hint: You borrow things here.

question: Where do we buy stamps to stick on letters? 🏷️
explanation: Wonderful! The post office sells colorful stamps for all our letters! ✉️
hint: The postman works here.

question: Where do we take our pet dog when it is sick? 🐕
explanation: Super! The animal doctor at the vet clinic takes care of our furry friends! 🐾
hint: It is a hospital for animals.

question: Where do we go to eat tasty food with family? 🍲
explanation: Awesome! The chef at the restaurant cooks a delicious meal for us! 🍕
hint: A waiter brings your order.

question: Where do we go to get our hair cut? 💇
explanation: Great job! The barber at the salon makes our hair look neat and tidy! 💈
hint: They use scissors and combs.

question: Where do we take a broken car to be fixed? 🚗
explanation: Fantastic! The clever mechanic at the garage fixes our cars and bikes! 🔧
hint: They use tools and oil.

question: Where do we buy fresh milk and butter? 🥛
explanation: Super! The dairy shop sells healthy milk, cheese, and yummy butter! 🧀
hint: It comes from cows.

question: Where do we go to watch a big new movie? 🎬
explanation: Awesome! We eat popcorn and watch fun movies on the big screen! 🎞️
hint: It is dark inside and has loud speakers.

question: Where should we walk to cross the road safely? 🚶
explanation: Great job! Zebra crossings have safe white stripes on the black road! 🚦
hint: It looks like an animal pattern.

question: Which traffic light colour means we must STOP? 🛑
explanation: Fantastic! A red traffic light keeps everyone safe by telling cars to stop! ✋
hint: It is the color of an apple.

question: Which traffic light colour means it is safe to GO? 🚗
explanation: Wonderful! The green light tells all the drivers they can drive safely! 🚙
hint: It is the color of leaves.

question: Which traffic light colour means we must WAIT? ⏳
explanation: Super! Yellow means get ready to stop or go, so we must wait carefully! 🚸
hint: It is the color of the sun.

question: Who stands on the road to guide the cars safely? 🚦
explanation: Awesome! Traffic police blow their whistle to keep cars moving safely! 🛑
hint: They wear a bright vest.

question: Where is the correct place to leave an empty car? 🅿️
explanation: Great job! A parking lot is a safe space just for resting cars! 🚙
hint: Look for the big blue P sign.

question: Where do we go to buy pretty roses and lilies? 🌸
explanation: Fantastic! The florist makes lovely bouquets out of colorful flowers! 🌺
hint: It smells very nice.

question: Where can we give our dirty clothes to be washed? 🧺
explanation: Super! The laundry shop uses big machines to clean and iron clothes! 🧼
hint: It uses lots of soap and water.

question: Where do we buy yummy ladoos and chocolates? 🍬
explanation: Awesome! The sweet shop makes the most delicious Indian sweets! 😋
hint: It is full of sugary treats.

question: Where can our pets run and play outside? 🐕
explanation: Great job! The dog park has lots of fun space for doggies to chase balls! 🐾
hint: It is an outdoor area for animals.
